en-US.description: Device drivers for Abbott diabetes devices
en-US.longDescription: LibreView Device Drivers needs to be installed on all computers that will be used to upload data via a USB cable. The LibreView Device Drivers locates the compatible device plugged into the computer and retrieves the data from the device to generate the reports.
en-US.name: LibreView Device Drivers
